audit_scope: Bounded local reconciliation/catalog/interface-census/finding-lifecycle paths plus a partial organization-wide code-search candidate register. Not a complete organization-wide repository-fleet audit.

consumers_and_producers.rule: DETECTED records discovery output only; it does not establish complete catalog coverage or VERIFIED status.
Schema validity and candidate-record validation do not promote candidates to CONFIRMED or VERIFIED.
Preserve the legacy report's own status and parser-coverage limitations. Do not promote its DETECTED output based on zero deltas or the independent report.
RECONCILED is scoped to the two supplied inventories and expected-delta contract; the producer explicitly states it is not VERIFIED.
The ledger requires independent RECONCILED plus zero blockers for its own resolution logic; RESOLVED does not imply merge approval or organization-wide VERIFIED status.
RECONCILED and VERIFIED counts are distinct. RECONCILED claims require reconciled contracts; VERIFIED claims require every contract to be VERIFIED. The current census is required to remain BLOCKED.
Unknown counts remain null and must not be treated as zero; the report preserves its explicit limitations.
Schema acceptance validates shape only; it is not proof of source completeness or verification.
VERIFIED requires exact-SHA checks and Run/Job/Step evidence; keep this lifecycle separate from legacy report statuses.
These values describe a finding's remediation lifecycle, not the status of reconciliation-report.json or the independent reconciliation gate. No implicit cross-domain mapping is allowed.
The lifecycle is separate from report status semantics.
Tests verify only the validator's defined reconciliation scope.
Negative tests reject implicit promotions, missing/invalid evidence, unknown statuses, incomplete organization scope, and commit-head mismatch.

residuals: Organization-wide discovery found candidate status producers, schemas, documentation, and potential consumers in atc-algorithm, a-townchain-ecosystem, globus-os, atclang, atc-standards, .github, and a-townchain-os-docs; see the discovery register for exact observed refs and limitations.

Code-search discovery is ranked/truncated and may reflect default-branch snapshots. Every candidate requires direct exact-commit inspection and executable producer/consumer classification; audit closure remains BLOCKED.
The audit does not yet prove complete active/private repository pagination, all workflow/script/status readers and writers, or per-repository exact-SHA workflow/job/step/artifact evidence.
Workflow evidence references must be revalidated on the final exact PR head after the final audit and schema changes.
